title: China Explores Using Widening US-Yuan Yield Gap to Boost Yuan's Global Role
detail: Analysis published Oct 9 examines how China is exploring the widening yield differential between US dollar and yuan-denominated assets as leverage to expand the renminbi's international footprint. With US Treasury yields elevated and Chinese bond yields comparatively lower, Beijing sees an opportunity to pitch the yuan as a portfolio diversifier and settlement currency, particularly among emerging market partners seeking alternatives to dollar dependency.

media.caption: China explores using widening US dollar-yuan yield gap to boost yuan's global role

title: Global Banks Expand Japan Debt Capital Markets Teams as Bond Issuance Surges
detail: International banks are staffing up their Japan debt capital markets (DCM) desks as a surge in Japanese corporate and government bond issuance drives deal flow. Rising Japanese yields — a consequence of the Bank of Japan's ongoing normalization — have attracted global fixed-income investors and made yen-denominated bonds more competitive on a hedged basis, prompting firms including European and US banks to add specialists in Tokyo.

media.caption: Global banks expand Japan debt capital markets teams as bond issuance surges amid rising yields
